tasks.title: 让设置页从共享外观元组派生选项
tasks.objective: 消除 AppearanceSettingsPane 中手写的 dark/light/system 列表，让设置 UI 与配置校验、类型共同追随 APP_APPEARANCE_IDS。
tasks.outcome: 设置页从 shared contract 导入 APP_APPEARANCE_IDS，并通过一个类型安全的显示名映射渲染全部选项。
acceptance: AppearanceSettingsPane 不再出现独立的 dark/light/system 元组，渲染集合直接来自 APP_APPEARANCE_IDS。
每个共享元组成员都能得到可读标题和说明；新增成员缺少显示映射时 typecheck 或 focused contract test 失败。
删除 APP_APPEARANCE_IDS 的 UI 调用或恢复手写列表时，focused SSOT test 变红。

verification.ref: CI=true pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/theme-appearance-ids.test.ts test/app-appearance.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Appearance settings derive their options from the shared tuple and runtime resolution remains intact.
The typed display mapping and settings component compile cleanly.
The shared appearance tuple has a production caller outside the contract test.

tasks.title: 让 Monaco 编辑器跟随 resolved App appearance
tasks.objective: 消除 EditorPane 和 DiffEditor 中固定的 vs-dark，让编辑器使用与 App chrome 相同的 dark/light 解析结果。
tasks.outcome: Editor 与 DiffEditor 共享一个 Monaco theme helper；配置或系统偏好变化时，已挂载编辑器会更新。
acceptance: EditorPane 不再写死 theme="vs-dark"，编辑器和 diff 编辑器都读取同一个 resolved Monaco theme。
dark、light 和 system 三种 App appearance 映射到 vs-dark 或 vs，系统偏好变化会重新解析。
删除 EditorPane 对 helper 或 theme prop 的调用时，focused source contract test 变红；Terminal palette 和持久化工作面不受影响。

verification.ref: CI=true pnpm --filter @agentmux/desktop exec vitest run test/monaco-theme.test.ts test/editor-theme-wiring.test.ts test/app-appearance.test.ts --maxWorkers=1
verification.proves: Monaco theme mapping, production wiring and system appearance resolution are covered.
The editor theme lifecycle compiles cleanly.
The shared Monaco theme helper is connected to the production editor surface.
